comment: fx_dynamics, compressor only. Xratio = 1 takes the expander out of the comparison, because plan section 5.13 defect P3 makes the prototype's expander realise 2 - 1/R and no inlet value fixes that. CscHiFreq and XscHiFreq are 20000 and NOT the gen~ default of 20 - defect P4, a stale hiShelf label, which at 20 Hz mutes the detector entirely. Cattack/Crelease are mapped by intent; the prototype wires them the other way round, so set options.dynMatchProtoTimeWiring true if you want the two envelopes to match instead.
